study: V7 causal local recoverability before continual recalibration

scope.primary_selection: six greatest numeric post_implant_day values among exposed T2 sessions; no replacement
scope.secondary: all exposed sessions including T3, with separate participant summaries

features.normalizer: first 30 seconds, fixed for all primary coefficient-update comparisons
features.local_normalizer_ablation: same past 120-second training window, independent of labels

models.loss: mean summed two-coordinate squared error; weighted mean for exponential variant
models.exponential_weight: 2 ** (-(fit_stop_bin - 1 - row_bin) * 0.02 / 60), normalized across selected valid training rows

evaluation.fit_stop: update minus 2 seconds; interval stop exclusive
evaluation.score: [update, min(update + 60, observed duration, 600)); identical valid-go mask and acquisition-block burn for every method
evaluation.session_metric: pooled future predictions across eligible scoring windows, not average window R2
evaluation.primary_metric: mean session R2 across six most recent exposed T2 sessions
evaluation.short_recordings: retain with explicit unavailable windows and session score; no replacement

bootstrap.unit: session within T2; participant for cross-person summaries

evaluation.dependence: no trial identifiers available; temporal embargo does not establish independent or disjoint trials
evaluation.label_reuse: earlier scored labels may train a subsequent update after the fixed delay; no future label access

gate.pass_rule: at least one declared eligible method satisfies every criterion
gate.selection_among_passes: highest mean T2 R2, ties resolved by listed eligible-method order
gate.multiplicity: bounded exploratory development gate; intervals are descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory evidence
gate.if_fail: stop before acquiring fresh data or building a continual controller; publish all results and diagnose limits of this representation/window family
gate.if_pass: freeze a separate continual-policy plan and complete source policy selection before opening fresh assessment outcomes

conditional_next_stage.fresh_selection_proposal: fixed next regular archive ranks 19 through 21 for T2,T5,T6,T7,T8,T9,T10,T11; separate acquisition lock before access
comparisons: drift-triggered sparse recalibration with scheduled probes
requirements: all labels including monitoring and rejected updates charged
full shared deployment interval including pre-detection failures
independent reconstruction of model and policy
report interruptions separately from prediction metrics
offline results do not establish closed-loop utility

publication: code, plans, aggregate results and independent audits only; no raw samples, model coefficients or sample predictions
